title: Water pricing
bodyMd: A utility introduces a higher tariff for usage above a monthly allowance. Total consumption falls, but the weather is also cooler than during the comparison month. The utility’s analyst recommends comparing usage with similar areas where the tariff did not change and accounting for weather. She warns that a simple before-and-after total cannot establish how much of the change the tariff caused.
